map.为什么 MPa 要乘 10？: Why must MPa be multiplied by 10?
map.1 kN/cm² = 1000 N ÷ 0.0001 m² = 10 MPa。若: 1 kN/cm² = 1000 N ÷ 0.0001 m² = 10 MPa. Doing only the kN/cm² division without multiplying by 10 gives a result ten times smaller than the true pressure, leading to far undersized selection.
map.实际锻造中存在摩擦、变形抗力波动与冲击载荷，留 25% 余量可避免闷车与模具损伤: Actual forging involves friction, variation in deformation resistance and impact loads, so leaving 25% margin avoids stalling and die damage. For cold forging or high-strength materials a factor of 1.3 to 1.5 is advised.
